description: A Curiosity rover visiting the Moon, parked at the Tranquility outpost. Shift and Ctrl raise and lower the throttle, which goes below zero to reverse (X sets zero), A/D steer the front and rear wheels, B brakes. It parks itself on its brakes when the throttle is at zero. Turn the camera mast using the Animations menu.
name: Curiosity Rover, Tranquility
